title: feat(lint,spec)!: refuse a holeless ${record.*} / ${result.*} action copy sentence, the last action-copy warning
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb1498XergPD9UgXyoeHSEDC)_

Fixes #25709

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## What changes

The console's action runner no longer fills `${…}` in an action's copy: `ActionRunner.confirmMessage` and `composeSuccessMessage` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` return a sentence with no `{{ }}` hole as written (objectui#13476, in the imported `ui/` tree on `main`). So the one action-copy shape the doors still kept a warning, a holeless `${record.*}` `confirmText` or `${result.*}` `successMessage`, is now an error at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate, like every other `${…}` token.

- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`: `isTransitionalDollar`, its warning branch and the `TRANSITIONAL` suffix are deleted. Every `closedScopeTemplateRefusal` finding is now `refuse(...)`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts`: `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` is retired (and its export in `ui/index.ts`). The module note and the `confirmText` / `successMessage` describes no longer say the shape is a warning; the stale `.objectui-sha` wording now names the `ui/` tree.
- `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`: `dollarOnlyTokenRoots` is retired; the lint branch was its only reader.
- Stale wording fixed: `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `validate-expressions.ts` (two comments), the conformance ledger rows `template-action-confirm-text` / `template-action-success-message`.
- Generated: `api-surface/ui.json`, `api-surface/automation.json`, `export-origins/ui.json`, `export-origins/automation.json`, and the reference pages the describes feed (`content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`, `ui/component.mdx`, `data/object.mdx`, `kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx`), all through `check:generated --fix`.

Landing point: as the order expected, `packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts` and `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`. No producer carries the shape (below), so nothing moves on the producer side.

The two retired exports are not in `@objectstack/spec@18.1.0` (the latest published version; read from its npm tarball: 0 hits for either name in `dist/`, against hits for `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`, the control). No published version carries them.

## Producer measurement (before the crossing)

Every action-copy sentence reachable from each module's exports, walked on the base `38050ced` and judged through the built `@objectstack/lint`:

| producer | confirmText | successMessage | errorMessage | with a `${…}` token | holeless `${…}` shape | lint copy findings |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `examples/app-crm` | 0 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `examples/app-todo` | 1 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `examples/app-showcase` | 6 | 24 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `examples/app-multi-package` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `@objectstack/platform-objects` | 68 | 256 | 16 | 0 | 0 | n/a |
| `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` | 0 | 9 | 0 | 0 | 0 | n/a |

**Count: 0 sentences of the shape in `examples/**`**, and 0 in the platform packages. Control: a planted `Delete ${record.name}?` `confirmText` on each example stack draws the finding (a warning before this change). A text scan of `examples`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins` and `packages/services` for a `confirmText` / `successMessage` line carrying `${` also answers 0. (The platform-objects counts include translation-map copies the deep walk reaches, so they are an upper bound on sentences, not a declaration count.) HotCRM was not re-measured here.

## The pending #25680 release note is corrected in this PR

`.changeset/25680-action-copy-refusal.md` is still pending (not yet released). Two of its sentences become false with this change, and they would ship in the same release: "**Still a warning.** …" (the holeless shape) and "`@objectstack/spec` adds two exports: `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` … `dollarOnlyTokenRoots`". This PR rewrites exactly those two sentences (plus "all but one" in the summary sentence) and adds its own changeset, `.changeset/25709-action-copy-holeless-dollar-refusal.md`.

This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class `check-empty-changeset.mjs` names, so `Check Changeset` stays red on purpose (route 0 of its message). **Confirmation requested in writing on this PR** that the rewrite of the #25680 note is wanted. `skip-changeset` is not applied.

## Pins flipped (load-bearing)

- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts`: the holeless `${result.email}` / `${record.name}` case now asserts `severity: 'error'`, its location, its `{{ }}` prescription and no "A warning, not a refusal"; the `action:group` / inline-action case asserts four errors; the publish-gate cases assert one error on the error channel and an empty advisory channel for a page write and an action write.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (c): through the real `saveMetaItem`, the holeless `${record.*}` page save now answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with one `expression-invalid` error prescribing `{{ record.name }}`, and nothing is stored.
- Spec: the `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` and `dollarOnlyTokenRoots` unit pins are deleted with their subjects; the export snapshot (`api-surface/`) pins their absence.
- Repo-wide sweep for the same meaning ("still fills", "transitional", "A warning, not a refusal, for now", the two symbol names): every hit outside `ui/` and released text is in this diff.

## Evidence

Final head `a3b0809d`.

- **Ablation** (committed fix first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore): the refusal branch was mutated back to a warning for a holeless `${…}` sentence. Lint unit file: 6 failed / 11 passed (the flipped pins). Rebuilt `@objectstack/lint`, `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the marker in 4 built files, then the protocol gate file: 1 failed / 210 passed (pin (c)). Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean.
- Tests: `@objectstack/lint` 163 files / 7335 tests passed; `@objectstack/spec` 722 files / 21881 passed (1 todo); `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` 211/211; `expression-conformance.test.ts` 8/8 on `a3b0809d`. Typecheck: `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 113 families, `--ran` reconciliation: 113 derived, 113 run): green except `check-empty-changeset` (the declared correction above, exit 1); `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no lock turn for the re-measure's closure build; unbuilt packages outside this closure): NOT MEASURED locally, CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs both. `check:skill-examples`, `check:dts-closure` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first read a dist mid-rebuild or a shallow clone and were re-run green. `check:doc-authoring` found a tracker id in the ledger string; fixed in `a3b0809d` and re-run green. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 0 anchors lost. `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- **Dogfood battery** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, launched at `5a6ed48a`; the ledger string edit of `a3b0809d` landed on disk 43 s into the run, so `expression-conformance.test.ts` was re-run on `a3b0809d` (8/8). VERDICT command-exit 1: Test Files 1 failed / 295 passed / 3 skipped; Tests 1 failed / 2522 passed / 18 skipped. The one failure is `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` "packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts — every positive control is still present in THAT file" (control `handleI18nRequest` expected 3, read 4). This diff touches nothing under `packages/runtime` or that test, so the failure does not come from it (inferred from the file list; the test was not re-run on the base `38050ced`).

## Acceptance notes

- Contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER is owed (narrowing).
- `outcomeMessages` and `ActionSchema.errorMessage` stay outside the family, unchanged.
